extensions.name: A-B loop
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Loops a passage of the song playing, like Spicetify's Loopy Loop: the playback bar button marks its start, then its end, and the song goes back to the start each time it reaches the end.

extensions.name: Album colours
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Albums and playlists take the colours of their own artwork, like Apple Music on Android: a wash under the header, or the whole page. On top of any theme.

extensions.name: Animated artwork
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The window's background is Apple Music's own full-screen background: the song's artwork as a slow, blurred, moving wash, faint behind the pages and the playback bar.

extensions.name: Artwork
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The artwork of the current track fills the window, under dark glass panels that float.

extensions.name: Artwork filters
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The artwork of the song playing, in the playback bar, at the top of its album and in full screen, in two inks of the accent, in black and white, in sepia or more vivid. Under the pointer, the playback bar's artwork takes its colours back.

extensions.name: Audio meter, example
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: For people who make extensions: writes the loudness and the peak of the sound to Ampify's log. It changes no sound and shows nothing in Apple Music.

extensions.name: Bookmarks
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Save songs, albums, artists and playlists from the context menu, or the exact moment of the song playing from the playback bar, like Spicetify's bookmark.js. Come back to them from the main menu.

extensions.name: Bottom playback bar
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Moves the playback bar to the bottom of the window, across its whole width, as in Spotify: the song on the left, the controls in the middle, volume, lyrics and queue on the right. Works without a theme.

extensions.name: Centred lyrics
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The lyrics sit in the middle of their panel, line by line, like a centred lyrics theme on Spicetify.

extensions.name: Cinema
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A dark room with one screen: deep black, the pages in a centred column with wide margins, and the playback bar as a floating capsule under it, tinted by the artwork of the song. The sidebar dims like house lights until the pointer comes over it.

extensions.name: Compact sidebar
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Tighter rows in the sidebar, so more of your playlists fit on screen, on top of any theme, like Comfy's compact sidebar on Spicetify.

extensions.name: Console
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Studio hardware: graphite panels with fine edges and square corners, the playback bar as a rack unit at the bottom, and a wide display in its middle with an equalizer that follows the music. Three accents, as schemes: amber, VU green and ice.

extensions.name: Copy link
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Copies the Apple Music link of a song, an album or a playlist from its menu, and what plays now with Ctrl+Alt+C.

extensions.name: Cosy
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A soft, flat evening look: the sidebar and the pages share one colour, the playback bar runs along the bottom with a large rounded artwork, and albums start under a wash of their own colours. Four schemes: Dusk, Night, Moss and Linen.

extensions.name: Cover ambience
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The song glows in the colours of its artwork and changes with each song, on the display or along the whole playback bar, like Spicetify's Cover Ambience.

extensions.name: Declutter
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Hides what most people never use (reactions, share, AirPlay, info banners) and, as settings, the search bar of albums and playlists, the quality badges, the explicit mark, Apple's suggestions and, one by one, the lyrics, Up Next, volume and download buttons.

extensions.name: Discord presence
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Your Discord status shows what you listen to: cover, artist, album, progress bar, links and buttons. Turn it on with Discord open. Covers and links come from Apple Music's catalog; a cover it lacks (your own files) goes to a free host that deletes it after a few months, which can be turned off.

extensions.name: Animated equalizer
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: An equalizer that moves with the music: bars, a line, a ring or mirrored bars. Its settings choose where it goes (the song's display, the artwork, the whole playback bar or the page background), its shape, how many bars, how high and how strong it shows, its colour, and thin or thick bars.

extensions.name: Ember
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Two glass panels over the colours of the song playing, the library and the pages, with the playback bar along the bottom and an amber accent.

extensions.name: Fluent
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Apple Music built like a Windows 11 app: the navigation and the controls on the window's Mica, the pages on one content layer with Windows' corner and hairline edge, Segoe UI Variable, and the accent on what acts. Light and dark.

extensions.name: Focused lyrics
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The lyrics blur away towards the top and bottom of their column, so the sung line and the lines around it stand out, as in Apple Music on the Mac and the iPhone.

extensions.name: Glass
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Apple's Liquid Glass: the song's artwork fills the window, and the sidebar, the pages and a floating capsule for the playback bar are clear panes over it, tinted by the music, with a bright rim of light.

extensions.name: Greenroom
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A familiar layout from another music app: the playback bar at the bottom across the window, the track on the left, rounded dark panels and a green accent.

extensions.name: Hello, example for creators
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: For people who make extensions: it shows nothing in Apple Music. The smallest extension, to read and copy: it writes to Ampify's log and counts the launches.

extensions.name: Hide explicit badge
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Hides the small E badge that marks explicit songs, on top of any theme.

extensions.name: High contrast
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Black and white with one bright accent, and outlines instead of shades: every panel, card and menu has a clear edge, and what is under the pointer gets an accent outline. A dark scheme and a light one.

extensions.name: Actions on hover
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The favourite, add, download and reaction buttons of a song appear only when the pointer is over its row, which keeps the lists calm.

extensions.name: Search on hover
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The search box fades out until the pointer reaches it and stays while you type, in the sidebar or in the top bar, on top of any theme, like Spicetify's Dynamic Search Bar.

extensions.name: Skip tracks from the keyboard
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Global shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+Right for the next track, Ctrl+Alt+Left for the previous one.

extensions.name: Large album artwork
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Makes the cover at the top of album and playlist pages bigger than Apple's, from 120 to 360 pixels, and loads it sharp at that size.

extensions.name: Listening stats
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Your top artists and songs and your listening time, like Spicetify's Stats. By default from Apple Music's own play counts, all your devices included; the last 7 days, the last 4 weeks and since the start count what plays on this PC.

extensions.name: Lyrics spotlight
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The line being sung stands on a soft tile of the song's colour in Apple's lyrics pane, and follows the song line by line, on top of any theme.

extensions.name: Lyrics style
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: How the lyrics read, in their pane and in the full-screen player: lines centred or at the left, the sung line on a soft tile of the song's colour, and a dark pane, plain or from the artwork, like Spicetify's centred lyrics, Dark Lyrics and Pretty Lyrics.

extensions.name: Minimal full screen
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Apple's full-screen player with less around the artwork: hide the title and artist, the times or the lyrics, and show the buttons only under the pointer, on top of any theme.

extensions.name: Mirror
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Apple Music turned around: the sidebar on the right, the pages on the left, and the playback bar under them at the bottom left. Calm neutral greys, light text on dark, one sea-green accent. A setting puts the sidebar back on the left.

extensions.name: New releases
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Recent albums, EPs and singles from the artists you listen to, like Spicetify's New Releases. Checked once a day in Apple's public catalog; click a release to open it in Apple Music.

extensions.name: Palettes
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: One calm layout, one colour scheme per family: Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Rose Pine, Nord, Gruvbox, Dracula, Rose gold and Midnight. One setting rounds every corner, from square to round; the playback bar goes at the top or across the bottom.

extensions.name: Light paper
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: An editorial look, as if printed: the sidebar and the pages are one sheet of warm paper parted by a hairline, titles in a serif, nearly square corners, ruled song lists and an ink-green accent. A dark scheme too.

extensions.name: Playback bar times
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The time played and the length of the song, shown while the pointer is over the playback bar or all the time, wherever the bar sits. On top of any theme, like Comfy's hoverable timers.

extensions.name: Progress line
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The progress line of the display thinner or thicker, with round ends, and a little animated mascot that rides it at the song's position: a comet, a bobbing note, a beating heart or a running cat, with a rainbow trail if you like, like Spicetify's thin, thick and Nyan Cat bars.

extensions.name: Progress mascot
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A little animated figure rides the progress bar at the song's position, like Spicetify's Nyan Cat bar: a comet, a bobbing note or a beating heart.

extensions.name: Progress line thickness
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A thinner or thicker progress line in the display, with round ends, on top of any theme, like Spicetify's thin and thick bar snippets.

extensions.name: React panel, example for creators
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: For people who make extensions: a panel written like React, without JSX, with a counter, a timer and settings (Ampify.React and Ampify.components). Nothing useful to listen with.

extensions.name: Corners
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: One radius for the covers, tiles, rows, the display and the menus, or square corners everywhere, the panels and Ampify's own included, on top of any theme, like Spicetify's Rounded Images and Be Square.

extensions.name: Last.fm scrobbler
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Sends the tracks you listen to to Last.fm (scrobbling). Turn it on, allow Ampify on the Last.fm page that opens, and you are done. Plays that could not be sent wait in storage.

extensions.name: Sidebar icons
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Gives every pinned item and playlist of the sidebar the same shape, round or square with softened corners, on top of any theme or none.

extensions.name: Sidebar style
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Tighter rows in the sidebar, so more of your playlists fit on screen, and one shape for every pinned item and playlist, round or square with softened corners, on top of any theme, like Comfy's compact sidebar on Spicetify.

extensions.name: Skip list
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Never hear a song, album or artist again, like Spicetify's Trash Bin and Auto Skip. Add from the context menu or the playback bar, manage the list from the main menu, optionally skip live versions, remixes and intros, and export or import the list as JSON.

extensions.name: Sleep timer
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Pauses the music after a delay set in minutes, counted from when Apple Music opens, and says so at the start.

extensions.name: Spinning artwork
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Example snippet: the artwork of the playback bar becomes a round record with grooves and a centre hole, and turns, with @keyframes and animation. Settings keep it still or take the grooves away, for a plain round artwork.

extensions.name: Square corners
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Example snippet: removes the rounding of buttons and frames, on top of any theme.

extensions.name: UI palette, example for creators
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: For people who make extensions: a panel with the grid, tabs, menu, check box, progress bar, spinner and divider components (Ampify.components). Nothing useful to listen with.

extensions.name: Volume percentage
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Shows Apple Music's volume as a percentage in the playback bar, next to the volume button, as Spicetify's Volume Percentage does.
